target.basis: Target of the historical Cuttlefish boot (docs/upstream/VALIDATION.md, 2026-10-24, framework 84183aff); that boot is not evidence for any current candidate. device/google/cuttlefish is pinned in os/pinned-manifest.xml (283645aa, android-17.0.0_r1). build.basis: Own OUT_DIR beside the Pixel outDir, under the shared builder lock; nothing is cleaned. droid builds the guest images into PRODUCT_OUT; hosttar is the host package goal (hostPackage). requiredImages is a minimum, not the full launcher input list, which is unverified for this tree. minFreeGiB is a policy margin, not a measured output size

hostPackage.basis: Read from the pinned device/google/cuttlefish 283645aa (no compile): build/cvd-host-package.go registers the Soong cvd_host_package module type, installs <module>.tar.gz into the module's host install directory (HOST_OUT) and declares the hosttar phony only for the vsoc board platforms; build/Android.bp declares cvd_host_package cvd-host_package; vsoc_x86_64_only/BoardConfig.mk sets TARGET_BOARD_PLATFORM vsoc_x86_64. There is no Makefile hosttar. Preflight checks the plugin's sha256 and these declarations in the retained tree, and lunch must resolve this board platform

sourceBinding.basis: The base of every preparation: the retained Pixel tree exactly as the last Pixel integration reconciled it, bound by the builder's latest host-reconcile receipt (file name and sha256), the candidate SHA and the dispatched apps of the run that wrote it. prepare refuses any other latest receipt and any drift from its entries; the build refuses any other candidate or app set. The retained tree itself is never built, edited or reconciled by the alpha
sourceBinding.evidence: Lead's read-only host inspection, 2026-10-28 (INFRA-ALPHA-082): reconcile receipt 0004-2026102804.json (written 2026-10-28T09:59:03Z) is the latest and none of its 15 entries has drifted; the immutable 2026102804 stage chain (000-init to 010-completed) names candidate ae9cfd4d; aapt and hashes of the integrated apps match 2804 (Rose Agent 302 01b184b4..., Calculator 4 9f46c1a2..., controller 28 f39936b1...). Measured 2026-10-28 11:53Z on the builder's ext4: reflink unsupported; the selection without .repo, keys, releases, out, out-*, out_* and .git/.repo everywhere allocates 120.16 GiB (1,696,997 files), so copyBudgetGiB 150 includes metadata and slack, and build.minFreeGiB 300 must remain free after it. 6,680 symlinks: 6,543 resolve inside, 135 dangle (contained fixtures, kept), the extracted factory-image cache vendor/adevtool/dl/unpacked (where the absolute device-path links live, including both /sys/kernel/debug links) is excluded as an exact cache boundary (INFRA-ALPHA-090, provenance in cacheBoundaries); any other escape stops preparation. imageVerification.basis: INFRA-ALPHA-087/088: the current OS alpha contract (os/alpha/cuttlefish-product-contract.json at preparation.osDelta, contract c825aa19, delta f21bf683, OS PR61) checked from the partitions in the built super.img, never from loose files. Rose app paths follow the contract: PRODUCT/app/RosePreinstall_*, SYSTEM_EXT/priv-app/PixelBackgroundControl, system framework-res and build.prop (system-as-root, as release-pipeline IMAGE_LOCATIONS). closure is the contract's Seedvault requirement (SYSTEM/priv-app/Seedvault and SYSTEM/app/LocalContactsBackup with their etc XML): module names, privileged flag, sub_dir and src file names from the pinned Android.bp files (OS fixtures os/tests/fixtures/cuttlefish-alpha/seedvault), packages from the pinned manifests and XML root elements and packages from the pinned XML files (scripts/tests/fixtures/seedvault-7cfffed7). These are compiled OS modules: their APKs must be readable with the pinned package; no version, digest or certificate is pinned for them and the Rose app signer does not apply. Pinned Cuttlefish shared/BoardConfig.mk packs product, system, system_ext, vendor and others into an A/B super image and leaves their file system to TARGET_RO_FILE_SYSTEM_TYPE, so the probe records BOARD_SYSTEMIMAGE_FILE_SYSTEM_TYPE and the guard requires its extractor (ext4: debugfs, erofs: fsck.erofs). simg2img, debugfs, aapt and apksigner are the Pixel pipeline's retained paths; lpunpack and fsck.erofs are the retained P1 release bin/ executables the lead measured (INFRA-ALPHA-090) and are pinned by sha256 in toolSha256; a different file fails the gate. No probe or image has been verified
